mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 73 degrees with clear skies at Reddan Soccer Park, and we have a waxing crescent moon in the sky.
The Verona Police Department has released a summary of notable calls from October 5 to October 12, highlighting several traffic accidents and an arrest in the 100 block of Prairie Oaks Drive.

There is plenty to do in town, with Hop Haus Trivia and Quizmasters Trivia happening today. Tomorrow, you can check out the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market, enjoy pizza at Lake Lou-ee, or attend trivia at The Mill or The Bogey Factory.
Among the incidents reported, on October 7, a 17-year-old riding an e-moto was involved in a collision at Basswood Avenue and Hemlock Drive, resulting in minor injuries.
The Culver's flavor of the day is Oreo Cookie Cheesecake. The restaurant is currently open until 10 PM tonight, so there is still plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
